items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: And the band includes Arthur Briggs, and Bobby Jones on trumpets; Billy Burns and Herb Fleming on trombones; Booker Pittman, clarinet and alto; Clay Sandler, alto; Roy Butler, alto, baritone; Alfred Pratt, tenor;

ctx.x: Do you know Chicago very well? Not well, but roughly.
Well, you can imagine what State Street was. It doesn't exist anymore. That's what a friend of mine, Roy Butler, from Chicago, he wrote and told me, he said, "You wouldn't know Chicago."
